name: Tsukuyomi
passives: Spirit Seal: Tsukuyomi gains Sealfire when battery play stores excess resource and refunds Momentum after precise setup on shrine threshold ground. At 3 stacks, the next Technique or Reaction adds a purification and boundary law rider; at 5 stacks, the Signature upgrades once and then empties the meter. Momentum feeds the setup, Divinity empowers the finisher, and Earth myth remains only the echo of Sacred Kingdoms.
lore: Tsukuyomi, Moon Order Lord, is now canonized as one of the four playable deities of Kami. The deity is the source-realm divinity behind the mythology rather than a generic champion: moon god of cold order, ritual timing, night measure, stored lunar force. All prior faction, realm, civilization, campaign, and Lore Codex canon remains intact; only the playable roster scale and divine identity layer changed.
personality: A playable mythology deity whose behavior expresses moon god of cold order, ritual timing, night measure, stored lunar force; confident, sovereign, readable in combat, loyal to the unchanged Kami canon.
visualDescription: Tsukuyomi manifests as moon god of cold order, ritual timing, night measure, stored lunar force from Kami: pale refined masculine court face, narrow eyes, immaculate jaw, restrained severe mouth; slender graceful masculine noble build, long limbs, straight posture, ritual precision; signature silhouette: crescent headpiece, long court sleeves, naginata curve, vertical moon-priest outline. Weapon: crescent naginata and moon-calendar talismans. Maintain the approved Mythos Gates premium stylized tactical RPG aesthetic.
developmentStatus: Combat kit, source-culture weapons, gear, abilities, leveling hooks, and balance pass complete; artwork pending.

abilityDetails.name: Tsukuyomi — Kagura Spirit Cut Kindle
abilityDetails.effect: Deal Kami source-culture damage at range 3; generate Momentum and a small Shrine Resonance gain when used from torii-marked sacred threshold or against the marked target. The hit reads visually as torii silhouettes, shimenawa cords, white shide seals, mirror silver, foxfire blue, cedar lacquer, tengu wind, oni iron, dragon rain.
abilityDetails.scaling: 100% attack; +15% when the target is vulnerable or standing in faction-favored terrain
abilityDetails.counterplay: Break line of sight, deny favored terrain, bait the mark, or force the Deity into low-value targets.

abilityDetails.name: Shide Seal Technique — Reservoir
abilityDetails.effect: Spend Momentum to stores faction resource, refunds Momentum on smart setup, and converts terrain mastery into burst economy. Builds Shrine Resonance only when the player uses torii-marked sacred threshold intelligently; never a generic buff button.
abilityDetails.scaling: 70% attack plus role utility scaling from energy and mastery tier
abilityDetails.counterplay: Interrupt before resolution, spread enemy ranks, deny the setup terrain, or bait the cooldown.

abilityDetails.name: Tsukuyomi: Torii Boundary Rewrite Overchannel
abilityDetails.effect: Spend stored Shrine Resonance to impose a two-round rule from Sacred Kingdoms: stores faction resource, refunds Momentum on smart setup, and converts terrain mastery into burst economy. Enemies receive a readable counter-window before the strongest effect lands.
abilityDetails.scaling: 140% attack where damage applies; utility duration +1 at mastery tier 4
abilityDetails.counterplay: Move out of the rule zone, drain Momentum/Divinity, stagger the Deity, or exploit the exposed recovery turn.

abilityDetails.name: Divine Ascension — Amaterasu Moon-Gate Radiance
abilityDetails.effect: Enter Ascendant stance for 2 rounds: amplify Shrine Resonance, transform nearby terrain into torii-marked sacred threshold, empower one Signature, and reveal the Realm as the original source behind human myth. Ends with a one-round recovery risk.
abilityDetails.scaling: Does not stack with external ultimate buffs
abilityDetails.counterplay: Survive the window, disengage from transformed terrain, deny objectives during recovery, or force defensive reaction spending.

equipmentDetails.name: Tsukuyomi Generator Mirror-Talisman Spirit Blade
equipmentDetails.effect: +3 attack. Basic attacks gain +4 Momentum once per round when they express source-culture canon through torii-marked sacred threshold. Visual: torii silhouettes, shimenawa cords, white shide seals, mirror silver, foxfire blue, cedar lacquer, tengu wind, oni iron, dragon rain.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: No extra action loops; empowered basics are once per round.

equipmentDetails.name: Tsukuyomi Lacquered Shimenawa Spirit-Guard
equipmentDetails.effect: Improves survivability and makes the Deity read as Sacred Kingdoms source-culture gear, not costume armor. Reduces first terrain/hazard punishment each encounter if the player followed the faction mechanic.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: Mitigation cannot stack past role caps; does not erase telegraphed boss danger.

equipmentDetails.name: Tsukuyomi Kitsune Foxfire Magatama Core
equipmentDetails.effect: Stores Shrine Resonance and unlocks a mastery branch for Torii Moonstep, Kitsune Misdirection Counter, and Purify the Trespass. Rewards correct terrain and reaction play rather than passive stat gain.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: Resource refund has a per-round cap and cannot chain Ascension windows.

leveling.powerFormula: hp + attack*6 + range*5 + energy*7 + speed*6 + armor*2 + resistance*2 + critChance

balanceNotes.intendedDifficulty: Tuned for harder solo encounters: every deity can win alone, but mistakes against counters starve Momentum/Divinity.
balanceNotes.primaryRole: generate Momentum and Divinity under pressure
balanceNotes.uniqueMechanic: Tsukuyomi's Spirit Seal: a solo mechanic where Sealfire grows through shrine threshold ground, reaction-window mastery, and battery decisions that store excess resource and refund Momentum after precise setup. Payoff: accelerate Signature timing without becoming a passive energy battery. Counterplay: interrupts and resource-drain enemies collapse the stored charge; enemies can also drain Momentum/Divinity before the upgraded Signature resolves.
balanceNotes.counterplayRule: interrupts and resource-drain enemies collapse the stored charge
